title: avengers run-record (v1)
description: The §6a instrumentation sink — the anti-superstition insurance. Every convene run writes <project>/.avengers/sessions/<id>/run-record.json (a NAMED artifact alongside the session-plan). It records the RESOLVED staffing (provider + effort per seat, WITH the seat-class name), the external-arbiter path + the fallback_arbiter_residual flag, the §2a advisory notes (e.g. 'no anti-sycophancy floor for this provider'), and the POST-RUN outcome fields (dissent margin + a crude arbiter-scored 1-5 grade) that the kernel/arbiter fill in after deliberation. convene.py writes the STAFFING half at plan-materialization time with the outcome half null (`graded: false`); the run fills the rest. This is what lets v3's measured routing start from data instead of zero and makes rotation meaningful if ever enabled. S081 (2026-09-14) edits v1 ADDITIVELY and without a version bump: seats and the arbiter gain the OPTIONAL `model` (requested) and `served_model` (provider-reported), and the effort enum drops `minimal` and adds `high` (no tier is retired). A record written before the change carries no new required key. S081 amendment 1 D6 (2026-09-15) adds, again additively, the OPTIONAL staffing-seat `substitute_for` / `substitution_reason` / `requested_model` (present only on a seat re-seated on claude at plan build). #282 r14 (2026-09-15) adds, again additively, the OPTIONAL `provenance` object on staffing seats and the arbiter (the plan's, copied; closed inside). A record without it still validates. #282 fix round 1 F15 (2026-09-16) adds, again additively, the OPTIONAL boolean `roster_invalid` inside that object (true only for a codex freeze honoured against an unreadable roster). A record without it still validates. DATA/machine state (stdlib JSON), never executed.

model.description: OPTIONAL. The plan-time resolved (REQUESTED) model for this seat, from skills/_meta/seat_model.py.

served_model.description: OPTIONAL. The model the provider REPORTED serving (codex stderr banner; agy/claude self-report labelled as such). Null or absent until observed; never back-filled from `model`. A measured-routing reader pools rows by served_model, never by model alone.

substitute_for.description: OPTIONAL (S081 amendment 1 D6). Present only on a seat convene re-seated on claude at plan build because astra could not serve its codex call. A measured-routing reader must not pool such a row with native claude seats without this field.

substitution_reason.description: OPTIONAL. rate_limit_reached | quota_exhausted | cli_missing | no_eligible_model. Present only with substitute_for.

requested_model.description: OPTIONAL. The codex model the seat would have used; null when no eligible model exists. Present only with substitute_for.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL (#282 r14; #282 fix round 1 F15). The seat_model pin provenance of the model convene resolved for this call, persisted at plan build: requested_selector (the role selector, e.g. TOP@xhigh), resolved_model (the resolver's choice before any env layer), source (freeze | env | roster | harness_literal), roster_fetched_at (the fetched_at of the roster the choice was made from; null when none was read), only when source is freeze frozen_slug (the seat-model-pins.json `top` as written), and roster_invalid (true, and absent otherwise) when the pin was resolved against a roster that could not be read — in a fail-closed convene only a codex FREEZE can be, since a freeze is honoured unvalidated as the operator's emergency override while every other codex path raises roster_invalid. A substituted seat carries the provenance of the Claude pin that serves it. #291 (2026-09-23, additive, no version bump): roster_rev, the model_roster REVISION the pin was resolved under, OPTIONAL and present only on Claude and codex-std pins, so a plan or record written before it still validates. Closed: no other key (live meter and event keys are not persisted).

model.description: OPTIONAL. The plan-time resolved (REQUESTED) model for the arbiter call (seat_model role `arbiter`).

served_model.description: OPTIONAL. The model the provider REPORTED serving for the arbiter call. Null or absent until observed; never back-filled from `model`.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL (#282 r14; #282 fix round 1 F15). The seat_model pin provenance of the model convene resolved for this call, persisted at plan build: requested_selector (the role selector, e.g. TOP@xhigh), resolved_model (the resolver's choice before any env layer), source (freeze | env | roster | harness_literal), roster_fetched_at (the fetched_at of the roster the choice was made from; null when none was read), only when source is freeze frozen_slug (the seat-model-pins.json `top` as written), and roster_invalid (true, and absent otherwise) when the pin was resolved against a roster that could not be read — in a fail-closed convene only a codex FREEZE can be, since a freeze is honoured unvalidated as the operator's emergency override while every other codex path raises roster_invalid. A substituted seat carries the provenance of the Claude pin that serves it. #291 (2026-09-23, additive, no version bump): roster_rev, the model_roster REVISION the pin was resolved under, OPTIONAL and present only on Claude and codex-std pins, so a plan or record written before it still validates. Closed: no other key (live meter and event keys are not persisted).

outcome.description: Filled POST-RUN by the kernel/arbiter. At plan-materialization time convene.py writes graded=false with both scores null.
